tools.name: fw_param
tools.description: One CLI setting of a firmware release: type, allowed range or values, firmware default (with no board config), the source line (settings.c or settings.yaml), and its history across releases (renames, range and default changes). Old names are followed through sourced renames.

tools.name: fw_diff
tools.description: What changed in the CLI settings between two releases: added, removed, renamed (only sourced renames) and changed (range, values, default) settings.

tools.name: fw_check_cli
tools.description: Checks a pasted `diff all` / `dump` against a release: every `set` line whose setting does not exist, was renamed or removed, or whose value is out of range or not in the value list, plus lines that only repeat the firmware default. The release of the paste is read from its `# Betaflight / ... X.Y.Z

tools.name: part_specs
tools.description: The full spec sheet of one part by its slug (the last segment of its fpv-db.com URL, e.g. iflight-xing2-2207 for /motors/iflight-xing2-2207/): specs, bench thrust table where measured, VTX table where published, the sources the specs were verified against, and caveats.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Finds published parts of one type by spec. `filters` maps a spec field to a number (equals, or any element of a list), a string (case-insensitive substring) or {min, max} (numeric range). `query` matches brand and model. An unknown field returns the type's field list. Example: type=motor, filters={"
